notes.title: Removed Translated Languages
notes.notes:
Sorry Everyone,
I'm a solo dev with literally no money, i publish games with my pocket money and can't pay for localization.

As languages were Auto Translated, i don't want to give you bad experience with it. please play in English or Hindi
